title: Tim Cook speaks out on the Cambridge Analytica scandal, says Facebook's collection of user data 'shouldn't exist' (AAPL)

persons.name: tim cook steve jobs mark zuckerberg

text:
Tim Cook Steve Jobs Mark Zuckerberg
Sunday, 25 March 2018 ( 6 hours ago )
· *In response to a question about the Cambridge Analytica scandal, Apple CEO Tim Cook said the situation was "dire."*
· *He said the ability of people to access personal data shows what websites that people browse or shows who their contacts are should "not exist."*
